# Marketplace

Get the perfect commands for your server, already built for you.

{% hint style="info" %}
Make sure to always follow the marketplace guidelines while using the website. You can check all the marketplace guidelines [here](https://botghost.com/market/guidelines).
{% endhint %}

## What is BotGhost Marketplace?

BotGhost Marketplace is a service for sharing and importing custom BotGhost commands and bots. With the BotGhost marketplace, you can now find the commands you need faster than ever before. You can additionally share your hard-made custom commands with others to import into their own bots.

## Add Commands with Marketplace

#### Step 1. Select a Command

On the [BotGhost Marketplace](https://botghost.com/market) page, click the top right **Add Command**. Once on the add command page, you will get a drop-down menu where you select a command you have made with your bot(s). It will show a list full of all of the custom commands you have made across all bots.

![](https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FZgUQesxRiRxcMOp4ZhIW%2Fimage.png?alt=media\&token=6dd9a834-93bc-49ff-929b-7112502b49b0)

#### Step 2. Add Commands Details

**Select a Command:** Add a name for your command. This will be displayed on the main page and in the search bar. Ensure that the name of the command is related to its function.\
\
**Add Details:** Add a tagline for your command. This will be the 'short description' if displayed on the main page. It is best to include a short description of your command to entice users into viewing it.\
\
**Long Description:** Add a long description for your command. This will provide a detailed explanation of your command when someone views your command. It is best to include all the features of the commands to entice users to import your command.\
\
**Add Tags:** Add tags for your command. This is important to get more views on your command. Adding tags to your command will boost it being seen in the search and main page. This is one of the most important aspects of your commands to reach other users.

**Add Images:** Add images for your command. Show off your command in image form to all viewers to see, these images will need to be approved by a staff member! Make sure to keep all images following the [BotGhost Market Guidelines](https://botghost.com/market/guidelines).

## Edit Commands with Marketplace

If you have something you would like to change about your command, you can do this by editing your command. You can do this by doing the following:

1. Click your profile on the top right corner. This will direct you to your profile and list all the commands you've posted.
2. Select the command you would like to edit and click the **Edit** button. Once in the edit page, you can change any setting of the command you would like.

## Delete Commands with Marketplace

If you do not like the command you've posted, you can always delete it. You can do this by doing the following:

1. Click your profile on the top right corner. This will direct you to your profile and list all the commands you've posted.
2. Select the command you'd like to delete, click the **Edit** button. Once in the edit page, scroll down and you will see an option to remove the command.

## Import Commands with Marketplace

If you find a command you like on BotGhost Marketplace, you can do this by doing the following:

1. Select the command you would like to import and click the **Add Command** button.
2. Once pressed the button, select which bot you would like the command to be added.
3. Congratulations! The command should have been added on your bot via Custom Command module. You can check via Dashboard.
